scenario: Sign in through actual portal UI, add a workspace, switch to a separate Edge tab, return after at least 30 minutes.
background_control: Static local page without application scripts, timers, or requests.
local_substitutions: Two toolkit custom elements use a disclosed local stub.
OUD identity, EMS2 entitlements, catalog, and analytics use synthetic local fixtures.
The actual JPA session repository uses an isolated H2 database.
The local Spring bootstrap omits unavailable private starters.
limits: Local observation cannot establish effective PROD settings or the reported user's browser state.
Sparse event observers add synchronous evidence writes but no timers or background network requests.
The separate control page shares the local server origin but runs no portal code.
